3 خَاسَؤُوا , (K,) inf. n. مُخَاسَأَةٌ, (S,) (tropical:) They threw stones, one at another; (S, K;) as also ↓ تخاسؤوا , (K,) or تخاسؤوا بِالحِجَارَةِ. (S.) And كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُمْ مُخَاسَأَةٌ (tropical:) [There was between them a contending in throwing, or throwing of stones]. (S, TA.) [See also art. خسى.] ―
-b2- And هُوَ يُخَاسِئُ means يُقَامِرُ [He contends in a game of hazard]. (IB, TA in art. خسو.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
